name: plumbline
description: Every number a coding agent writes into paper/*.tex must recompute from the repository's raw data: a short recipe per number, checked by hooks at each edit.

mode.title: Check mode
mode.description: feedback: report failing numbers after each edit and never block (default). gate: deny edits whose numbers do not recompute, revert shell writes to .tex, block Stop while a number fails. log: only log.

max_stop_blocks.title: Stop blocks (gate mode)
max_stop_blocks.description: How many times the gate may keep a session from ending while a tagged number fails.
